info.title: runic-translations
info.description: Deterministic validation and generation tool for Runic Translations.

commands.name: completion
commands.description: Generate bash, zsh, fish or PowerShell completions

options.name: --project
options.description:
Translations directory or its runic.json.
Defaults to ./runic.json, then
./translations/runic.json.

options.name: --output
options.description: Directory to write the artifacts to. [required]

options.name: --emit-json
options.description: Render locale-v5 JSON and its asset manifest.

options.name: --emit-esm
options.description:
Render the ESM package and
web-module-manifest-v3.json.

commands.name: init
commands.description: Create an RMF2 translation project and starter resources.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Directory to create the project in. [required]

options.name: --default-locale
options.description: Base locale tag, such as en. [required]

options.name: --namespace
options.description: Namespace of the generated C# API. [required]

options.name: --class
options.description: Class name of the generated C# API. [required]

options.name: --no-starter
options.description: Create the files without the starter message.

commands.name: lsp
commands.description: Run the RMF2 language server over standard input/output.

commands.name: schema
commands.description: Write the bundled JSON schemas to a directory.

options.name: --output
options.description: Directory to write the schemas to. [required]

commands.name: serve
commands.description:
Run a persistent compiler for development servers over
standard input/output.

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validate catalogs and report translation diagnostics.

options.name: --project
options.description:
Translations directory or its runic.json.
Defaults to ./runic.json, then
./translations/runic.json.

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Check that generated artifacts match the sources.

options.name: --project
options.description:
Translations directory or its runic.json.
Defaults to ./runic.json, then
./translations/runic.json.

options.name: --output
options.description:
Directory with the artifacts to compare.
[required]

options.name: --emit-json
options.description: Compare locale-v5 JSON and its asset manifest.

options.name: --emit-esm
options.description:
Compare the ESM package and
web-module-manifest-v3.json.
